'''Rodney Stuckey''' is the starting [[point guard]] at [[Eastern Washington University]]. The sophomore is averaging 24.6 points, 5.5 assists, 4.7 rebounds, and 2.4 steals per game. Against [[Portland State University|Portland State]], he scored a season high 36 points. It was one of nine 30-point games he has put together this season. He's also gotten to 10 assists, three times, and had a career high 7 steals against [[University of Idaho|Idaho]]. 

In only two seasons, he has scored 1,438 points, made 983 point field goals, collected 279 rebounds, dished out 283 assists, and collected 145 steals. He has the potential to break a lot of school records in the future. He has declared for the 2007 NBA draft, and many mock draft sources have him going midway in the first round.

Stuckey's distant cousin, [[Chansi Stuckey]] from [[Clemson University]] was drafted by the [[New York Jets]] in the 7th Round of the [[NFL Draft]].
